name: tg-games
description: Telegram LLM RPG Bot — текстовые RPG-игры на базе LLM с движком-редуктором JSON-состояния

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/bot
scripts.build:admin: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/admin-api && npm run build -w apps/admin-web
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build -w apps/admin-api && npm run build -w apps/admin-web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run dev -w apps/bot
scripts.dev:support: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run dev:support -w apps/bot
scripts.dev:support:admin: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run dev:support:admin -w apps/bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/bot && npm run typecheck -w apps/admin-api && npm run typecheck -w apps/admin-web
scripts.lint: eslint "packages/core/src/**/*.ts" "apps/bot/src/**/*.ts" "apps/bot/tests/**/*.ts" "apps/admin-web/tests/**/*.test.ts" "packages/schema-contract/tests/**/*.ts" && npm run lint -w apps/admin-api && npm run lint -w apps/admin-web
